novelty_delta: Test whether one site carries which explicitly introduced person performed an action, expressed as the correct he-versus-she continuation, across independently worded active-voice and passive-voice constructions. The linked location rewrite must remain invariant, and the same site must not transfer an unrelated explicit pronoun-copy task with identical output tokens. This extends pronoun-class and gender-readout evidence to natural, answer-changing antecedent counterfactuals; rediscovering head 12.4 or MLP17 without A1/A2 transfer and control selectivity is not novel.
decision_changed: If native capability passes separately in every construction and ordered direction and one site transfers both A1 and A2 while sparing P and C, promote that site to held-out subspace identification for a construction-general antecedent state. If capability fails, record an invalid instrument. If no site is selective, record a fast-screen null; do not relabel the established pronoun announcer or gender readout as antecedent binding.
